title: Canonical geometric operations on varying-ring systems
statement: For an arbitrary inverse sequence of commutative rings $R_n$ with maps $\phi_n:R_{n+1}\to R_n$, on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] use the constant sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and the actual semilinear module-sheaf systems (module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]) on the vertical sequence site of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Write $\mathscr S_X$ for this abelian category and $D(\mathscr S_X)$ for its ordinary unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For every scheme map $f:X\to Y$, define $f_{*,\bullet}$ to have sections $M_n(H\times_Y X)$, with the canonical constant scalar map and the original semilinear transitions. Define $f^*_{\bullet}$ by its left-adjoint universal property; it is exact and additive. For an open immersion $j$, define $j_{!,\bullet}$ as the left adjoint to $j^*_{\bullet}$ given by the localized direct-sum extension and sheafification [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]; it is exact. On the ordinary unbounded derived categories set $G_f=D(f^*_{\bullet})$, $P_f=Rf_{*,\bullet}$ and $J_j=D(j_{!,\bullet})$, with adjunctions induced from the ordinary ones. Ordinary direct-image composition is the unique comparison given by restriction along fibre-product pasting on every section. Inverse-image composition is its unit-preserving adjoint comparison; derived proper composition is its right-adjoint conjugate. Open composition is likewise the unit-preserving comparison. Normalize identities by the pullback graph and adjunctions. Exact evaluation at $n$ has the ordinary identity-on-sections pushforward comparison and the inverse-image comparison uniquely specified by the unit equation. Localize inverse-image evaluation, and define derived pushforward and open-extension evaluation by their adjunction mates; these mates are invertible by simultaneous sections and localized extension. The single-level functors are those of [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. No flatness, finiteness, boundedness or cartesianness of systems is assumed.

source.place: Tags 03DI, 03DJ, 09AE; Zheng Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10, vertical sequence-site specialization.

proof.text: For ordinary pushforward evaluation, use the strictly commuting square of the level inclusion Prod.sectR and the product site functor id_N times pro-etale base change. The level ring map equals the corresponding component of ringMap, since the chosen constantRingIso is the adjoint of the canonical constant direct-image map. Compose the two continuous module pushforward composition isomorphisms with congruence for that equality of ring maps. Each component is the identity on sections. Extensionality of sheaf module maps, natural transformations and isomorphisms proves uniqueness (moduleEvalP_existsUnique).

source.place: Tag 03DA, continuous module direct image; identity on sections and adjunction for constant ring maps

proof.text: For pull_exact, take additivity of the left adjoint from additivity of push. Apply the componentwise short-complex exactness criterion of semilinearDerivedSections. The already stated unit-normalized moduleEvalG identifies each evaluation of pull with exact evaluation followed by the existing exact single-ring pullback. Transport exactness through that natural isomorphism and use the abelian exact-functor criterion to obtain preservation of finite limits and finite colimits. This step uses the retained moduleEvalG_existsUnique statement in this same node, without introducing a replacement hole.

source.place: Tags 03DA and 03EK; Zheng Construction 4.1, componentwise exactness

proof.text: For pull_isRightAdjoint at an open immersion, evaluation of a semilinear system is continuous module pushforward along the level inclusion and therefore has a left adjoint. Transfer the small-site module adjunction through AsSmall for the independent object and Hom universes. Thus evaluation preserves all limits. The existing single-ring open pullback is also a right adjoint, so moduleEvalG makes every level evaluation of the system pullback limit preserving. The conservative limit-preserving forgetful functor from sequence-site modules to presheaves of abelian groups reflects limits, and presheaf limits are pointwise. Hence the system pullback preserves all limits. Its source is Grothendieck abelian and consequently complete, well-powered and has a small coseparator. Apply the special adjoint functor theorem.

source.place: Tag 03DI; alternative proof of adjoint existence using Mathlib Adjunction/AdjointFunctorTheorems.lean and GrothendieckCategory/Coseparator.lean
